position_overview: Discover Peliplat Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We're evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact; transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience. With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films; it's where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time. From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we're building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation. On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema. Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema! What Will Your Next Role Look Like? As a Content Operations Specialist at Peliplat, you will play a central role in building and activating our interactive cinema community. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of content, community, and live operations. You will create and curate content, activate users and creators, and operate Virtual Screening Rooms as high-impact social experiences. From writing and editing to live event execution and viral content creation, you will help turn every user interaction into engagement, and every event into growth.; by driving user participation, supporting creators, and helping scale our self-sustaining UGC ecosystem. This role is ideal for someone who can be both creative and driven, and excited to operate in a fast-paced, startup environment. * Please include your portfolio, either integrated within your resume (as a single document) or provided as a link we can access. If your portfolio includes a password code, kindly specify it. Key Responsibilities Content Creation & Curation Support content planning aligned with campaigns, screenings, and platform initiatives Identify and amplify high-performing UGC and community content Contribute to storytelling formats that drive engagement across the platform Produce and curate high-quality content, including film reviews, editorial pieces, and shortform video content Community & UG

On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema. Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema! What Will Your Next Role Look Like? As a Content Operations Specialist at Peliplat, you will play a central role in building and activating our interactive cinema community. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of content, community, and live operations. You will create and curate content, activate users and creators, and operate Virtual Screening Rooms as high-impact social experiences. From writing and editing to live event execution and viral content creation, you will help turn every user interaction into engagement, and every event into growth.; by driving user participation, supporting creators, and helping scale our self-sustaining UGC ecosystem. This role is ideal for someone who can be both creative and driven, and excited to operate in a fast-paced, startup environment. * Please include your portfolio, either integrated within your resume (as a single document) or provided as a link we can access. If your portfolio includes a password code, kindly specify it. Key Responsibilities Content Creation & Curation Support content planning aligned with campaigns, screenings, and platform initiatives Identify and amplify high-performing UGC and community content Contribute to storytelling formats that drive engagement across the platform Produce and curate high-quality content, including film reviews, editorial pieces, and shortform video content Community & UGC Operations Manage daily community activities, including discussions, circles, polls, and engagement initiatives. Drive user participation across pre-watch, during-watch, and post-watch phases. Foster a strong, positive, and interactive community culture. Lead the execution of Monthly Writing Challenge operations and special event community challenges, including liaising with partner organizations under the supervision of the Manager of Public Relations. Creator & Influencer Activation Take ownership of creator growth by actively sourcing and recruiting new content creators, critics, and co-watching hosts across online platforms and in-person events, while onboarding and supporting their success on the platform. Guide creators on how to host engaging sessions and grow their presence on the platform. Identify high-potential users and nurture them into active contributors. Support incentive mechanisms to drive consistent content creation. Content & Growth Capture key moments from screenings (reactions, discussions, highlights) Edit and produce short-form video content for in-app and external platforms (TikTok, Instagram, etc.) Collaborate with Marketing to create viral content loops that drive installs and awareness Turn live events into scalable, shareable content Data & Performance Optimization Track key metrics such as engagement, event participation, content performance, and user activity Analyze trends and provide insights to improve content, events, and community strategies Continuously optimize workflows, formats, and creator activation strategies Support operational tracking using tools like Excel or Google Sheets Screening & Event Operations Set up and execute Virtual Screening Rooms, including scheduling, video configuration, and live event management. Act as the on-site operator during live events, ensuring a smooth, engaging, "cinema-like" experience Support flagship events (e.g., creator-led watch-alongs) to generate high engagement and shareable moments. Troubleshoot live issues and optimize user experience in real time. Who You Are Someone who can blend between content creator + community builder + operator. Passionate about film, internet culture, and digital communities. Highly execution-driven with strong attention to detail. Creative, analytical, and action-oriented. Comfortable working in live, fast-moving environments. Proactive, adaptable, and resourceful. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Media, Film, or related field. 2-4 years of experience in content operations, community management, or content creation. Strong writing and communication skills in English. Spanish, required. Experience with UGC platforms, creator ecosystems, or social communities. Hands-on experience with short-form video creation/editing (e.g., CapCut or similar tools). Strong understanding of digital content trends and audience behaviour. Ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment. Nice to Have Experience working with influencers or managing creator communities. Background in film, media, or entertainment content. Familiarity with analytics tools and performance tracking. Experience with live-streaming or event-based platforms. Our Culture As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in; it's how we execute. We are building more than a platform; we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience. This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy. Our culture is rooted in people who don't just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them. Ownership - Think Like a Builder Strategic Hustle - Create Value Beyond Budget Problem-Solving - Decode Complexity Result Oriented - Drive Real Impact Market Intelligence - Know the Game Passion for Cinema & Community - Build What You Believe In No recruiters, please.
